facts.fact: Lunar 落在厨房台面上鸣叫点击，还学微波炉「哔」了一声。
facts.anchor: whistled and clicked happily, then beeped like the microwave

facts.fact: Lunar 献上一朵粉花，落掌即把与 Jamie 的记忆一次性砸回来。
facts.anchor: As soon as the pink flower hit her palm, she was slammed by memories

facts.fact: 哭到力竭后她摸鸟头，对 Lunar 承认自己很想他。
facts.anchor: she reached out and rubbed the velvety-soft feathers on the bird’s head

facts.fact: Jamie 对 Mia 说 Amrita 没回电话、没做任何联系。
facts.anchor: She hasn’t returned my call, or made any effort to contact me

facts.fact: Rayenne 说是门房 Claude 给她开的门，她已在走廊等她。
facts.anchor: A very nice gentleman called Claude opened the door for me

facts.fact: Rayenne 说她的天赋是阈限魔法，像导乐陪人穿过人生转折。
facts.anchor: threshold magic – a little like a doula

facts.fact: 隔天她打给 Katie，宣布回来帮忙，下一通电话给 Sylvie。
facts.anchor: I am. And I want to help. My next call will be to Sylvie.

facts.fact: Rayenne 靠在走廊窗边等她，而不是按门铃。
